description: This file defines API endpoints related to user profile management in a sports live-streaming backend. It includes routes for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and searching user profiles, utilizing FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and Pydantic models.

methods.name: create_user_profile( profile_data: UserProfileCreate = Body(...), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new user profile for the current authenticated user.

methods.name: get_my_profile( db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to retrieve the profile of the current authenticated user.

methods.name: update_my_profile( profile_update: UserProfileUpdate = Body(...), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT request to update the current user's profile.

methods.name: get_profile_by_id( profile_id: str, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to retrieve a user profile by its profile ID, with visibility checks.

methods.name: search_profiles( q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search query for display name or username"), favorite_sport: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by favorite sport"), location: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by location"), verified_only: bool = Query(False, description="Show only verified profiles"), limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Number of profiles to return"), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of profiles to skip"), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to search for profiles based on query parameters. Returns public profiles unless the requester is trusted.

methods.name: delete_my_profile( db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE request to remove the current user's profile.
